title: Collect UI
brief: A gallery of collected user interfaces for design inspiration. Shared link-only; the description is inferred from the site's name and unverified from the message.
caveat: Shared link-only; the description is inferred from the site's name and unverified from the message.
details: Collect UI (collectui.com) is a daily design inspiration gallery and network for UI designers. It curates interface designs as browsable visual references and markets itself to designers with over a million monthly impressions, positioning listings next to premium tools like Framer, Mobbin, and Adobe. Useful as a pattern and layout reference library when researching interface design directions.
